text: Onsari Gharti Magar (Nepali: ओनसरी घर्तिमगर) is a Nepali communist politician and current parliamentarian. She made history by becoming the first female Speaker of the Parliament of Nepal, a position she was elected to unopposed on October 16, 2015.[2][3] Prior to this, she served as Deputy Speaker of Parliament[3] and held the office of Minister of Youth and Sports in the cabinet led by Jhala Nath Khanal.[2] Gharti Magar was elected to the Constituent Assembly (CA) from Rolpa constituency-2 in the second CA election. She later entered the House of Representatives in 2017 through a party list.[citation needed] In the 2013 Constituent Assembly election, she contested from Rolpa-2. She is married to Barsha Man Pun, who was formerly the secretary of the Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist-Centre).[2] This article about a politician from Lumbini Province is a stub.
